exposure: Lactating women (Caesarean delivery vs. vaginal delivery, exclusive breastfeeding vs. not)
cohort: 1211 pregnant and lactating women from three representative regions in China
finding: Maternal plasma folate concentrations decreased as pregnancy progressed and were lower in women residing in the northern region, with younger age, higher pre-pregnancy BMI, lower education, multiparity, and in lactating women who had undergone a Caesarean delivery or who were breastfeeding exclusively.
mod_finding: Lactating women who had undergone a Caesarean delivery had lower folate concentrations.
